Text: The Big Tech Test Key names: Microsoft (MSFT), Alphabet (GOOGL/GOOG), ServiceNow (NOW), GE Vernova (GEV), Fortinet (FTNT) and Vertiv (VRT). Wednesday is arguably the week's biggest day for understanding the AI investment cycle. Microsoft and Alphabet will be under particular scrutiny. Investors will want to see whether cloud growth remains strong, whether AI products are generating meaningful revenue and whether massive infrastructure spending is beginning to deliver sufficient returns. The distinction matters: AI adoption is one thing; profitable AI monetization is another. ServiceNow offers a different perspective, with investors watching enterprise software demand, subscription growth and the commercial adoption of AI-powered tools. Beyond software, GE Vernova and Vertiv represent the physical infrastructure supporting rising electricity and data-center demand. Their results and guidance may help investors assess whether investment in power generation, electrical equipment and cooling infrastructure is translating into real business growth. The Federal Reserve's rate decision also lands Wednesday, potentially influencing market sentiment alongside earnings. On this same day, we can't forget T-Mobile as we question the proof of its telecom demand. Fortinet to prove it is a cybersecurity giant. Eyes on FedEx, eBay, Ford and Chipotle as well. The key takeaway: Watch both sides of the AI equation — the companies building AI capabilities and the companies supplying the infrastructure needed to run them. $MSFT - $GOOG - $NOW - $FTNT - $VRT
